August 30, 2026 – 2:39pm

People who complain about 60Hz refresh rate screens on iPhones are full of it. I grant you, modern phone screens are really nice. They are bright and the colors are vivid. But I cannot tell a difference in the experience of a 120Hz screen from one with a 60Hz refresh rate in daily use. And my guess is that most regular consumers would not either. Maybe if I had two phones side by side and really looked for the difference I would see it. But otherwise it is spec sheet inflation and a drain on precious battery life. A 60Hz screen on a phone gives you much better battery. And that is a difference you will notice in daily use.

October 21, 2025 – 7:17pm

Apple should create an Apple Watch face that mimics the seven segment displays on old digital watches. It would be a cool retro look that I think would be popular with people of a certain age who fondly remember the Casio they once had when then were younger. It's odd to me that Apple has spent their effort on Apple Watch faces that are based on traditional round designs but have not created even one face that celebrates early digital displays. I bet they could make one that looks really attractive.

October 18, 2025 – 9:49pm

Never buy a GoPro camera. Full stop. Their app is garbage. Their customer service is non-existent. And their camera batteries have a very, very short life. I had one fail a couple of months (!) into owning a GoPro Hero 12, and another one just failed on me today, no warning. Missed recording an epic autumn bike ride because of it. When I contacted GoPro about the first battery failure, they ignored me. Well, I've had it. They suck. This is my first experience owning an action camera and I will never buy another product from them as a result. I look with envy at people I know with Insta cameras, particularly the Insta 360.

September 28, 2025 – 10:54am

I cannot understand all the hate being directed at Alien: Earth. This is some of the best television I’ve seen in quite some time and a wonderful addition to the Alien franchise. I loved the season finale and foundation that has been established for a next season — I have to assume a show this excellent will get a second season. I tell anyone who likes the Alien movies — or the sci-fi horror genre more generally — that this is worth watching. I am excited to see where this story goes.
